evidence.text:
Tried Lolinda out as a group of 6!

We had reservations, and were led upstairs and pretty quiet for the most part …
Fresh, delicious oysters! Very clean and quiet. The crab in sauce was—unfortunately—crushed (it’s better on Castro), but the service was pleasant and fast.

Absolutely my favorite French bistro in San Francisco. Small, intimate, charming, unpretentious, spectacular food and wine, and located in a quiet, safe, sweet neighborhood near the Castro District. …
Very affordable. Perfect location if you want a quiet night or on your way into Castro. Friendly staff. Had a lot of regulars at the restaurant while we were there.

Met a friend for an early Saturday dinner before we went to a party. We sat on a sofa and it was quiet and cozy and easy to talk. It was only 5 PM so very early and there was (almost?) nobody there. So I guess if you want a more exciting …

Quaint French spot with great service. I took my grandparents here for lunch and it was chill and quiet enough for them. The wine selection is incredible and their specials rock! I chose this place because it was open on a Sunday and was able to seat 7 people. The food was great!

Cafe Mystique is one of those cozy Castro spots that quietly surprises you. The grilled salmon with spicy coconut sauce is the move. Rich, flaky salmon with a creamy sauce that has the perfect amount of heat. The service is genuinely …

Adorable little place with a surprising amount of seating. A lot of great brunch items, the bacon eggs Benedict and the breakfast burrito were fantastic with great portions. Quiet, friendly vibe with people working on laptops and families getting breakfast. Fast and friendly service.

This place doesn't catch the eye on the outside but inside they decorated quite cute. But it was so quiet when we went on a Sunday maybe it was odd time. Food: the sashimi and salad was pretty fresh but the rolls were so small, overpriced …
Dinner happy hour here felt like a small escape from the city noise. The space is bold, colorful, almost like stepping into a painted dream. …

Plate with creamy mushroom sauce over sliced meat and small side of pasta, plus assorted salads and fried hash-browns. creamy mushroom sauce with sliced meat. pasta/ravioli in sauce. salad with lettuce and cabbage. carrot slaw. crispy hash-browns or hash-like potato. frosted dessert or fried item on plate. wooden table. knife and fork. salad bowls. small bowls with greens. plates with whiteware. beverage glasses in background. warm lighting. noise from dining setting
